description:
Get the exact on-chain native ETH balance of an address on Ethereum or Base, in wei and ether. get_wallet_portfolio already includes native ETH in its holdings — call this only for a standalone balance without a portfolio scan.

Use when: Use when a wallet's gas-availability or standalone ETH amount must be verified block-accurately. Do not call after or alongside get_wallet_portfolio — the holdings list already includes native ETH.

Limitations: Native ETH only; ERC-20 balances require get_erc20_balance. Requires an EIP-55 checksummed address. Ethereum mainnet and Base only.

Alternatives: get_wallet_portfolio, get_erc20_balance
name: get_eth_balance
title: Get Eth Balance
